proposal_title: London-AM range break confirmed by retest-hold

module_api.pnl_fields: NONE (the scored runner books every trade through the accounting kernel)

reuse: research/assets/forex/sessions.py local_wall_to_utc + zoneinfo Europe/London and America/New_York

groups: 1 hand-computed state-machine goldens (range/break/retest-hold/void/control complement/neighbour E_B/both-sides sign rule/tie)
2 end-to-end golden UP+DOWN trades with exact prices/times, booked through accounting.PositionBook (exact pnl/cost literals)
3 PIT/one-event-lag + mutation (post-entry bars cannot alter a forced-flat schedule; invalidation-bar mutation moves only the exit, never the entry)
4 DST 2025-03-09, 2025-11-02 (US), 2025-03-30, 2025-10-26 (EU): London windows and 16:00-NY flat at correct UTC (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST), evidenced on the regime-carrying Mondays
5 forced flat + absent 16:00-NY bar (early-forced-flat fallback and the unresolvable NO_TRADE case)
6 missing-bar fail-closed (invalid day, no fill-forward, no rescue by later bars)
7 determinism (identical schedule_digest twice; digest = sha256 of canonical JSON record)
8 governor caps incl. binding weekly case (3 RT then skip-never-queue; next week trades)
10 distinct anchor/neighbour/control digests on an all-three-fire fixture
11 dummy publication refusal (no authorization => refuse; scored=false => refuse real publish; zero-byte dummy dry-run only)
12 REAL-SNAPSHOT schedule-only frequency audit (NO PnL): 7 pairs x 3 arms tier 1.0

real_snapshot_frequency_audit.cross_check_vs_a9f: A9-F pre-implementation simulation: 1.70 RT/pair/week, 571 binding pair-weeks; this implementation: 1.6853 RT/pair/week, 572 binding pair-weeks (anchor) - independent confirmation

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: dispatch note: 'week = Sun 21:00 NY based'; proposal JSON utc_week_definition: '[Monday 00:00Z, next Monday 00:00Z)'
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: proposal JSON (frozen, authoritative): [Monday 00:00Z, next Monday 00:00Z). Equivalence: every tradable instant lies between London 12:00 and New York 16:00 on a weekday, so no RT can fall in the Sunday-evening window where the two definitions differ; assignments are identical.

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: retest_hold_state says 'On a later completed bar b'; the break bar itself can satisfy the retest inequality
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: resolution scan starts strictly AFTER the break bar (a 'subsequent' retest per the economic mechanism); the break bar is never its own decision bar.

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: void_state counts only 'before any retest-hold'; neighbour retest is a different law (E_B) than the void's L_B reference
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: the void block is the anchor's L_B retest-hold (the law the void is defined against); a neighbour-only fire does not block a later void, but a void kills the neighbour's day as frozen ('voids the day for the anchor and neighbour arms').

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: 'exact tie => no trade' is not one of the three named resolutions (retest-hold/void/NO_RESOLUTION)
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: counted as a decision with reason TIE_NO_TRADE (the day is terminal and audit-relevant); no trade for any arm.

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: dispatch summary: 'missing 16:00-NY flat bar => NO_TRADE'; proposal forced_flat rule: 'exit at the OPEN of the immediately preceding existing H1 bar, recorded as early_forced_flat'; proposal missing_bar_rule: '... (or earliest-available scheduled exit for forced-flat only)'
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: proposal JSON implemented: when the 16:00-NY bar is absent, exit at the latest existing bar strictly between entry and the flat instant (early_forced_flat; 69/81/130 such exits anchor/neighbour/control on the real snapshot - the A9-F Friday case); when NO such bar exists the trade cannot be flattened and is dropped as NO_TRADE (MISSING_FLAT_BAR). Both behaviours are evidenced in test group 5.

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: 'decision_ts' could be the decision bar-open stamp or its close instant
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: decision_ts = decision bar CLOSE instant (open+1h), the PIT moment the decision becomes known; entry_ts = next H1 bar-open (equal to decision_ts at tier 1.0, +1h at tier 2.0).

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: the invalidation exit bar can be absent after the entry was scheduled
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: fail-closed: the whole trade is dropped (MISSING_EXIT_BAR), never fill-forwarded; the only exit fallback is the forced-flat one. A trade dropped by a cap or a missing bar consumes no governor budget (it never becomes a round trip).

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: 'earlier of invalidation-exit and forced-flat' can tie exactly
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: tie resolves to exit_reason='invalidation' (deterministic; identical fill instant either way).

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: warmup_bars=48 purpose ('bar continuity only') leaves the first evaluable day implicit
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: first evaluable London-local date = London-local date of bar 48, reported as warmup_first_evaluable_date (2020-01-31 on the real snapshot); earlier days are never evaluated.

spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.topic: tie between invalidation scan and forced-flat window
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.tension: how far the invalidation scan may run
spec_ambiguities_and_resolutions.resolution: scan covers completed bars from the entry bar through the forced-flat bar inclusive; a scan hit whose (delayed) exit instant would land after the flat instant exits forced-flat instead.

attestation.no_repairs: no proposal file was modified; proposal_2.json digest verified unchanged; no post-audit amendment of any kind
attestation.no_real_data_pnl: no PnL, cost, or return is computed, printed or stored anywhere for real data; the audit is schedule-only (trade counts, decisions, cap/week histograms, digests)
attestation.lane_scope_only: only the four owned files were created/modified; no other file touched
attestation.one_heavy_task: pgrep -fl pytest checked before each run; no other heavy worker active
